points.description: Gives at least three valid factors affecting water consumption from the model list: climatic conditions, geography of the region, extent of industrialization, quality of lifestyle, quality of water available, population of the area (any wording).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for two valid factors (or one to two if vague); 0 for none valid.

rubric.notes: Full marks for about three of the four requested factors from the model list, in any wording (e.g. weather, industries, standard of living, population). Give 1 mark if only one or two valid factors are given. Wrong extra factors do not cost marks; 0 if none are valid.
